Subsidie Circular: De subsidieregeling C: Circular Plastics grant: The Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) grant scheme is a funding instrument from the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) aimed at accelerating the transition to circular use of plastics in the Netherlands. The scheme supports research and practical projects in the plastics and recycling value chain.

Het onderscheid zit in de fase en schaal: The distinction lies in the phase and scale of the project: research projects focus on knowledge development, while showcase projects demonstrate feasibility at a larger practical scale.
Kunststof is een van de meest gebruikte: Plastic is one of the most widely used materials in Dutch industry, but its recycling and reuse lag far behind the technical possibilities already available.
Veel plastic eindigt nog altijd als afva: A great deal of plastic still ends up as waste or in low-value applications, even though the value chain could in principle reuse the raw materials. CPNL aims to close that gap: from linear use to demonstrably circular applications.

De subsidieregeling Circular Plastics NL: The Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) grant scheme is a funding instrument from the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) aimed at accelerating the transition to circular use of plastics in the Netherlands. The scheme supports research and practical projects in the plastics and recycling value chain.
CPNL is open voor partijen actief in de: CPNL is open to organisations active in the plastics and recycling value chain. Participation always takes place through a collaboration: an application by a single party is not possible. Examples include combinations of companies, knowledge institutions and other organisations in the value chain.
